payload.body_they: {{Name}} tends to do best in relationships where closeness leaves both people enough independence to maintain a life of their own. They may be drawn to people who question conventional relationship rules, which makes the two of them define commitment for themselves. Freedom still needs a shared meaning. A relationship can look unconventional and remain dependable if both people know what they can rely on and which choices affect them both.
